name: rollinggo-trip
description: rollinggo 旅行 · RollingGo Trip — 多 Agent 协作的开源智能旅行助手

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:doppler: doppler run -- concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.secrets:sync: doppler secrets download --no-file --format env > .env && cp .env apps/server/.env
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/integrations && tsc --noEmit -p packages/services && tsc --noEmit -p packages/agent && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/evals && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.eval:test: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/evals/tests/*.test.ts apps/server/test/evalChecks.test.ts apps/server/test/agentRuntime.test.ts apps/server/test/agentHarnessTools.test.ts apps/server/test/agentOverviewSync.test.ts apps/server/test/agentSubagent.test.ts apps/server/test/humanInLoop.test.ts apps/server/test/healthCheck.test.ts apps/server/test/mealEnrichment.test.ts apps/server/test/llmCompat.test.ts apps/server/test/placeNameMatch.test.ts apps/server/test/draftValidate.test.ts apps/server/test/agentTripDraft.test.ts apps/server/test/agentWriteTools.test.ts apps/server/test/dayPlanner.test.ts apps/server/test/poiTaskSource.test.ts apps/server/test/projection.test.ts apps/server/test/projectionChannel.test.ts apps/server/test/projectionAdapter.test.ts apps/server/test/generationTask.test.ts apps/server/test/agentTranscript.test.ts apps/server/test/generationIdempotency.test.ts apps/server/test/durablePhase.test.ts apps/server/test/editClaim.test.ts apps/server/test/generationStatus.test.ts apps/server/test/planningPrompt.test.ts apps/server/test/delegate.test.ts apps/server/test/agentQuestions.test.ts apps/server/test/completionMessage.test.ts apps/server/test/dayTrim.test.ts
